**RidgeKey 1.1** - RidgeKey now keeps itself up to date.

### New
- 🔄 **Check for updates** - **About → Updates**, or **RidgeKey → Check for Updates…** in the menu bar. RidgeKey asks GitHub for the latest release, downloads the package, verifies its SHA-256 checksum and opens it in Installer. Optional automatic check (at most every 6 hours, on by default); nothing installs without your click.
- ⌨️ **`ridgekey-update`** for Terminal: `ridgekey-update` (check), `download`, `install`.
- Readers: Synaptics **06cb:00bd** reported working by a user.

### Install or upgrade
- **From 1.0:** download **`RidgeKey-1.1.0.pkg`** below and open it (1.0 has no updater yet). From now on, updates come from the app.
- It isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID: the first time, right-click → **Open** (or System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**).
- Fingers, the stored password and settings are kept.

### Files
| File | For |
|---|---|
| `RidgeKey-1.1.0.pkg` | double-click installer |
| `ridgekey-1.1.0-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` | Terminal install / inspection; `BUILDINFO.txt` lists the exact sources |
| `*.sha256` | checksums (the updater checks the `.pkg` against its file) |

Full history: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/labrouss/RidgeKey/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
